usagePrompt:
Multi-screen adds a dual-chart trading view to an Orderly DEX: two independent TradingPage panels side by side, each with its own symbol selector and localStorage-persisted symbol (so left/right selections survive a page reload). Layout stacks vertically below 1024px viewport width.

Install:
1. `npm install @pacrypto55/multiscreen` (peer deps: react, react-dom, react-router-dom, and @orderly.network/hooks, types, trading, ui-scaffold, plugin-core ^3.1.x).
2. Register the plugin so the "Multi-screen" entry auto-appears in your main nav:
   `<OrderlyAppProvider plugins={[registerMultiscreenPlugin()]} ...>`
3. Mount the route yourself (no page-injection API exists in the SDK yet, so this step is manual):
   ```tsx
   import { MultiScreenLayout, MultiScreen } from '@pacrypto55/multiscreen';
   import '@pacrypto55/multiscreen/styles.css';

   <Route path="multiscreen" element={<MultiScreenLayout mainNavProps={...} footerProps={...} bottomNavProps={...} onRouteChange={...} />}>
     <Route index element={<MultiScreen tradingViewConfig={...} sharePnLConfig={...} />} />
   </Route>
   ```

Known limitation: hiding the order book / markets sidebar inside each panel relies on CSS targeting Orderly UI's internal class names (documented in src/styles.css), since the SDK has no public prop for this yet. Re-verify those selectors if you're on an SDK version outside the pinned ^3.1.x range.
